# Category Test URL Expected Result Details
Test Methodology: Each URL is tested with a fetch(..., { method: 'HEAD', mode: 'no-cors' }) request. A request that fails (network error, blocked by extension) is counted as blocked. A request that succeeds (opaque response) is counted as allowed. EasyList, YouTube Ads, and Tracking URLs should be blocked. Legitimate URLs should be allowed.
